events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Street, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product sampling, refreshments, giveaways and a photo moment.
events.what_is_free: VEFB+ sample while supplies last, complimentary Spindrift and croissant, scratch-off giveaway; first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is organized by BOBBI BROWN Cosmetics and confirms Thursday, September 17, noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Multiple current NYC event sources independently match the date, hours, location and free sampling. Giveaways are while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample. The sources reviewed do not establish that an Eventbrite reservation is mandatory for entry.
events.practical_notes: Open public pop-up. Arrive early for limited samples and the first-100 deluxe sample. Photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social and digital channels.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with cat-treat sampling, games, merchandise prizes and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples, plus chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise through claw-machine and scratch-off games.
events.caveats: TEMPTATIONS and parent company Mars both confirm September 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery and describe the physical activation as free. No RSVP requirement is published. Treats and prize merchandise are promotional giveaways and may be limited by supply.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation, noon–6 PM each day. A separate virtual Cat Bodega continues online through September 26.

events.event_name: CHANEL — Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu Event
events.what_it_is: A CHANEL fragrance experience centered on Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu, with personalized fragrance discovery, Coco Mademoiselle products and makeup.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fragrance experience; CHANEL describes appointments as limited and explicitly encourages walk-ins.
events.caveats: CHANEL's official event page confirms a second public weekend September 18–20 at 873 Washington Street. Appointments are limited, but walk-ins are encouraged. The official page does not say an appointment guarantees entry, so this listing does not describe access as guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Appointments are optional and limited; walk-ins are encouraged. Friday hours differ from Saturday/Sunday, so each day is represented as a separate occurrence.

occurrences.details: Free public newsstand pop-up; samples and giveaways while supplies last.
